title: Triage SDC Checksum Mismatch and Numerics Errors
description: Deterministic diagnostic action to analyze XLA Silent Data Corruption (SDC / XSC) checksum mismatch logs (`XLA_SDC_CHECKER`), LLO deterministic replay and runtime bounds check failures, and NaN/Inf numerics divergence across retries and hosts to classify hardware defects vs XLA compiler bugs vs application non-determinism.

logs.description: Raw or formatted log entries containing XLA_SDC_CHECKER, checksum mismatch, BoundsCheck, or NaN/Inf telemetry.

logs_file.description: Optional file path containing the workload logs (e.g. scratch/queried_logs.txt).

start_time.description: Optional ISO-8601 start timestamp for log query fallback.

end_time.description: Optional ISO-8601 end timestamp for log query fallback.
